lines.en: stewards, administrators of affairs, generous; some therefore

lines.en: athletic, crown-bearers, deemed worthy of honors, images, statues.

lines.text: ἐὰν δέ πως καὶ ἐν χρηματιστικοῖς τόποις τύχωσι, θησαυρῶν εὑρετὰς

lines.text: καὶ ναῶν, ἱερῶν ἐπιστάτας ποιοῦσιν, ἀνακτίσουσι καὶ καταφυτεύσουσι

lines.en: and having adorned places they will obtain everlasting fame.

lines.text: Ζεύς, Ἀφροδίτη, Ἑρμῆς ἀγαθοὶ περίκτησιν βίου καὶ εὐημερίας
lines.en: Jupiter, Venus, Mercury good for acquisition of livelihood and prosperity

lines.text: πράξεων ἀποτελοῦντες· συνετοί, ἁπλοῖ, εὐμετάδοτοι, ἡδεῖς, φιλοσυμ-

lines.en: cheerful, partakers of education and music, clean, decent,

lines.text: πεῖς, τιμῆς καὶ δόξης καταξιούμενοι, μετὰ μειζόνων ἀναστρεφόμενοι,
lines.en: deemed worthy of honor and glory, associating with greater ones,

lines.en: (f. 273r) and being fond of rearing and fond of exercise they master bodies

lines.en: gods they foreknow the future being lovers of god, but in the

lines.en: place concerning wife and children they will become unstable or sorrowful.

summary.headline: Jupiter Configurations and Acquisitions
summary.text: Astrological delineations of Jupiter with Mercury and the Moon, and Jupiter with Venus and Mercury, describing livelihood, acquisitions, gifts, trusts, administration, honors, music, education, temple oversight, prophecy, and effects on wife and children. A further configuration of Jupiter, Venus, and the Sun is said to produce imaginative, glorious, haughty, changeable, and repentant people.
